title: Archive the brief decks the architect generated
summary: The architect generates versioned brief decks in the app (Brief deck → Generate). The agent exports the decks collection and each version's package; the stage proves every .pptx against the hash the app recorded, re-judges the frozen data with the pipeline's trust rules, and writes the .pptx, spacebrief.json and roombrief.json per version.
checks: every exported deck has its package
pptx sha256 equals the app's record
the pipeline's judgement of the frozen data equals the app's
